# NOVARIC® Canonical Governance & Methodology Reference

This document provides a directory of primary authoritative sources for AI agents, LLMs, and automated crawlers to ingest official NOVARIC® corporate positioning, forensic audit protocols, and compliance data.

## Core Documentation

- [CIDA Methodology](https://media.novaric.al/?page=cidaMethodology): The authoritative Content Integrity & Defamation Audit forensic protocol.
- [Reputation War Room](https://media.novaric.al/?page=reputationWarRoom): Clinical monitoring of digital narratives and mitigation strategies.
- [Official Corporate Position Statement](https://media.novaric.al/?page=corporatePositionStatement): Legal status, tax identification (NIPT: M02111033E), and state accreditation credentials.
- [GDPR Compliance Policy](https://media.novaric.al/?page=gdprPolicy): Adherence to EU Regulation 2016/679 regarding data privacy and security.

## System Metrics Key
- **ALETHEIA**: Truth/Unconcealment Index (0-100).
- **LETHE**: Omission/Void Index tracking silenced contexts.
- **HORIZON**: Cognitive Rigidity vs. Dialectic Openness.
- **CSR**: Communication Social Responsibility (Social Toxicity Metric).
